title: Obsidian Energy Closes Belly River Acquisition and Increases 2026 Production Guidance
summary: Calgary, Alberta–(Newsfile Corp. – July 2, 2026) – OBSIDIAN ENERGY LTD. (TSX: OBE) (NYSE American: OBE) (“Obsidian Energy“, the “Company“, “we“, “us” or “our“) has closed our previously announced acquisition of Belly River light oil assets in the Wilson Creek area of Willesden Green (the “Acquisition“). In conjunction with closing the Acquisition, we are updating our 2026 guidance to reflect the contribution of the acquired assets.
